name: io.github.knofler/myai
description: Self-hosted continuity OS for AI agents — persistent memory, state, tasks, and budgets.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_LOCAL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Local auth token for the self-hosted gateway MCP endpoint (sent as the x-gateway-local-token header). Generated by `myai up`.

environmentVariables.name: MONGODB_URI
environmentVariables.description: MongoDB connection string for the gateway's memory/state store. Defaults to the bundled Docker Compose MongoDB.
